hook.en: Who scored above 75? Which students are from Mysuru? Whose marks are missing? One command, SELECT, answers all of these.
hook.kn: 75 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಯಾರು ಪಡೆದರು? ಮೈಸೂರಿನವರು ಯಾರು? ಯಾರ ಅಂಕ ಇಲ್ಲ? SELECT ಎಂಬ ಒಂದೇ ಆಜ್ಞೆ ಇವೆಲ್ಲಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Write SELECT with WHERE, relational and logical operators
Use DISTINCT, BETWEEN, IN, LIKE, IS NULL

narration.en: Who scored above 75? Which students are from Mysuru? Whose marks are missing? One command, SELECT, answers all of these.
narration.kn: 75 ಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಯಾರು ಪಡೆದರು? ಮೈಸೂರಿನವರು ಯಾರು? ಯಾರ ಅಂಕ ಇಲ್ಲ? SELECT ಎಂಬ ಒಂದೇ ಆಜ್ಞೆ ಇವೆಲ್ಲಕ್ಕೂ ಉತ್ತರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: SELECT columns FROM table WHERE condition; returns matching rows; SELECT * returns all columns. Conditions use relational operators (=, <, >, <=, >=, <> or !=) and logical operators (AND, OR, NOT). DISTINCT removes duplicate rows. A column alias renames a column in the output: SELECT SName AS Name.

points.en: DISTINCT removes duplicates; AS gives an alias

narration.en: SELECT picks columns, FROM names the table, and WHERE keeps only rows that satisfy the condition.
narration.kn: SELECT ಕಾಲಂಗಳನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, FROM ಕೋಷ್ಟಕ ಹೆಸರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, WHERE ಷರತ್ತು ಪೂರೈಸುವ ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ಉಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: BETWEEN, IN, LIKE, NULL and ORDER BY

body.en: BETWEEN a AND b includes both ends. IN (list) matches any value in the list. LIKE matches patterns: % stands for zero or more characters, _ for exactly one character. NULL is tested with IS NULL or IS NOT NULL, never with =. ORDER BY column sorts the result, ascending by default; add DESC for descending.

points.en: LIKE: % = any number of chars, _ = one char

narration.en: BETWEEN includes both ends, IN matches a list, LIKE matches patterns with percent and underscore, NULL needs IS NULL, and ORDER BY sorts.
narration.kn: BETWEEN ಎರಡೂ ತುದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ, IN ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, LIKE % ಮತ್ತು _ ಬಳಸಿ ಮಾದರಿ ಹುಡುಕುತ್ತದೆ, NULL ಗೆ IS NULL ಬೇಕು, ORDER BY ವಿಂಗಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: Run SELECT queries on a sample table and watch the rows change as you edit the WHERE clause. Change > 75 to >= 78 and see whether a row appears or disappears. Try LIKE 'A%' and then LIKE '%a' on the name column.

problem.en: Table STUDENT(RollNo, SName, Gender, City, Marks) has 6 rows: (1, Asha, F, Mysuru, 85), (2, Ravi, M, Hubballi, 72), (3, Meena, F, Mysuru, 91), (4, Kiran, M, Mangaluru, NULL), (5, Arjun, M, Mysuru, 64), (6, Divya, F, Hubballi, 78). Write queries for: (a) students with marks above 75, highest first; (b) names starting with A; (c) students whose marks are missing.

steps.en: (a) SELECT SName, Marks FROM STUDENT WHERE Marks > 75 ORDER BY Marks DESC;  → Meena 91, Asha 85, Divya 78
(b) SELECT SName FROM STUDENT WHERE SName LIKE 'A%';  → Asha, Arjun
(c) SELECT SName FROM STUDENT WHERE Marks IS NULL;  → Kiran

answer.en: (a) Meena 91, Asha 85, Divya 78; (b) Asha, Arjun; (c) Kiran

narration.en: Let us work through this together. Table STUDENT(RollNo, SName, Gender, City, Marks) has 6 rows: (1, Asha, F, Mysuru, 85), (2, Ravi, M, Hubballi, 72), (3, Meena, F, Mysuru, 91), (4, Kiran, M, Mangaluru, NULL), (5, Arjun, M, Mysuru, 64), (6, Divya, F, Hubballi, 78). Write queries for: (a) students with marks above 75, highest first; (b) names starting with A; (c) students whose marks are missing.

problem.en: Using the same table: (a) SELECT DISTINCT City FROM STUDENT; (b) SELECT SName FROM STUDENT WHERE City IN ('Hubballi', 'Mangaluru');

steps.en: (a) City values are Mysuru, Hubballi, Mysuru, Mangaluru, Mysuru, Hubballi.
DISTINCT keeps each once → Mysuru, Hubballi, Mangaluru.
(b) Rows from Hubballi or Mangaluru → Ravi, Kiran, Divya.

answer.en: (a) Mysuru, Hubballi, Mangaluru; (b) Ravi, Kiran, Divya

narration.en: Now two board and CUET pattern questions. Read each one carefully before you answer.

points.en: SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE retrieves matching rows.
points.kn: SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE ಹೊಂದುವ ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: DISTINCT removes duplicates; BETWEEN is inclusive; IN matches a list.
points.kn: DISTINCT ನಕಲು ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; BETWEEN ಎರಡೂ ತುದಿ ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; IN ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: LIKE uses % and _; NULL is tested with IS NULL.
points.kn: LIKE % ಮತ್ತು _ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ; NULL ಅನ್ನು IS NULL ನಿಂದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ.

points.en: ORDER BY sorts, ascending by default.

homework.en: Write a query to list names ending with 'a' from STUDENT and predict the output.

narration.en: Recap. SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE retrieves matching rows. DISTINCT removes duplicates; BETWEEN is inclusive; IN matches a list. LIKE uses % and _; NULL is tested with IS NULL. ORDER BY sorts, ascending by default.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. SELECT ... FROM ... WHERE ಹೊಂದುವ ಸಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. DISTINCT ನಕಲು ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; BETWEEN ಎರಡೂ ತುದಿ ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ; IN ಪಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. LIKE % ಮತ್ತು _ ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ; NULL ಅನ್ನು IS NULL ನಿಂದ ಪರೀಕ್ಷಿಸಿ. ORDER BY ವಿಂಗಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಪೂರ್ವನಿಯೋಜಿತವಾಗಿ ಆರೋಹಣ.
